test_name: Verify Navigation to Men's Section and Product Interaction
description: This test verifies that the user can navigate to the Men's section and interact with product listings by viewing details and adding a product to the cart.
steps: Navigate to the homepage at https://atid.store.
Locate and click on the 'MEN' navigation link in the main menu.
Verify that the page redirects to the Men's section.
Scroll through the product listings to ensure all men's products are visible.
Click on the product link for 'ATID Yellow Shoes'.
Verify that the product detail page for 'ATID Yellow Shoes' is displayed.
Add the product to the cart by clicking on the 'Add to Cart' button.
Verify that the cart updates and displays the added product.
expected_results: The Men's section page is displayed.
All Men's products are visible on the page.
The product detail page for 'ATID Yellow Shoes' is displayed.
The cart updates to show the added product.
edge_cases: The 'MEN' link is non-clickable or missing.
The page fails to load the Men's section.
No products are displayed in the Men's section.
The product detail page fails to load after clicking on a product.
The cart does not update after adding a product.
data_requirements: At least one product in the Men's section.
The product 'ATID Yellow Shoes' must exist.
The cart functionality must be active.
The 'MEN' link must be present on the main menu.
The product detail page must be configured for 'ATID Yellow Shoes'.
dependencies: The Men's section page is available.
The product 'ATID Yellow Shoes' exists in the database.
The 'Add to Cart' functionality is implemented.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch products for the Men's section.
POST request to add a product to the cart.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the Men's section.
Response time for adding a product to the cart.
accessibility_requirements: All interactive elements must have accessible labels.
Ensure the navigation link 'MEN' is keyboard-accessible.
Verify color contrast for product listings in the Men's section.
